title: skills: objectstack-ui list-view and app-shell prose teaches traps the Views, dashboards and app-shell checks now catch (after #38107)
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of a delivery in review. PR #38107 (card #35143, Views, dashboards and app-shell family) adds `list-view-filter-field-virtual` (error), `list-view-kanban-group-field-uncategorical`, `dashboard-without-widgets`, `app-navigation-empty`, `object-unreachable-from-navigation` and `object-without-view` (warnings). Card #35143's Scope says: "When a family lands, the matching trap leaves the published skills where it is taught as prose." The PR's `Skills-docs:` line names the two files below.

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`: where it teaches, as prose, that a filter on a formula field fails or that a board needs a select to group by, point at the rule ids and their fixes instead.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`: the same for navigation reach / an object with no list view, if taught there.

Prerequisite: PR #38107 merged. `skills/**` may be a governed path; the PR follows whatever review that path needs.
Suggested-grade: p3 · prose follow-up of a landed check.
Dedupe: `list-views.md formula filter`, `kanban groupBy skill` found only #35143 and PR #38107. Precedent: #37529 and #37814 (the earlier families' skills follow-ups).
